title: Adult Medicine
excerpt: Comprehensive primary care for adults, including preventive care, chronic disease management, and acute illness treatment.
content: Our adult medicine team provides complete primary care services including annual wellness exams, management of chronic conditions such as diabetes and hypertension, immunizations, and same-day sick visits.

title: Pediatrics & Adolescent Health
excerpt: Dedicated care for infants, children, and teens from birth through age 18.
content: Our pediatric team provides well-child visits, immunizations, developmental screenings, and care for acute and chronic illnesses. We partner with families to support healthy growth at every stage.

title: Dental Care
excerpt: Affordable dental services for the whole family, including cleanings, fillings, and extractions.
content: Our dental team offers preventive, restorative, and emergency dental care. We accept Medi-Cal Dental and offer a sliding fee scale for uninsured patients.
